parsed.name: Pylontech RS485 通信协议组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非实体的通信协议组件，用于通过 USB 转 RS-485 串口适配器与 Pylontech 协议设备进行报文收发。它负责数据包的前后缀处理、校验和计算与校验、接收超时处理，以及串口连接与接收缓冲区管理，适合在实验系统中作为底层串口通信辅助模块使用。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical communication/protocol component for sending and receiving packets to Pylontech-protocol devices through a USB-to-RS485 serial adapter. It handles packet prefix/suffix framing, checksum calculation and validation, receive timeouts, and serial connection and RX buffer management, making it suitable as a low-level serial communication helper in laboratory systems.

actions.description_en: Receive one Pylontech-protocol packet from the RS-485 serial port and check its length, framing bytes, and checksum.

actions.description: 计算给定数据的校验和。

actions.description_en: Send one Pylontech-protocol packet over the RS-485 serial port, automatically adding framing bytes and checksum.
